findings.title: Carelon Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines: Musculoskeletal - Joint Surgery
findings.quote: Failure of at least 12 weeks of non-surgical conservative management
findings.note: Current version replacing 2023-11-05; listed as current on guidelines.carelonmedicalbenefitsmanagement.com/current-musculoskeletal-guidelines/. Covers shoulder arthroplasty, shoulder arthroscopy/rotator cuff repair, hip arthroplasty, hip arthroscopy, knee arthroplasty, knee arthroscopy. Landing page: guidelines.carelonmedicalbenefitsmanagement.com/joint-surgery-2025-11-15/. A future 2026-11-15 version is already posted.

Fetched Carelon Joint Surgery 2025-11-15 PDF: it does NOT address ACL reconstruction/repair. No Anthem-specific public ACL medical policy or clinical UM guideline located in searches; governing criteria for 29888 not publicly identified (likely internal/MCG review).

findings.title: Cigna Medical Coverage Policies - Musculoskeletal: CMM-601 Anterior Cervical Discectomy and Fusion (V1.0.2026)
findings.quote: Less than clinically meaningful improvement with at least TWO of the following (unless contraindicated): prescription strength analgesics, steroids, gabapentinoids, and/or nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) for six (6) weeks
findings.note: Current replacement for stale mm_0527 (2020). CPT 22551 confirmed in codes table. Related current docs: CMM-604 Posterior Cervical Fusion and CMM-605 Cervical Microdiscectomy, both V1.0.2026 eff 08/04/2026, same evicore.com/cigna listing.

findings.title: Cigna Medical Coverage Policies - Musculoskeletal: CMM-606 Lumbar Microdiscectomy (Laminotomy, Laminectomy, or Hemilaminectomy) (V1.0.2026)
findings.quote: MRI/CT shows neural structure compression at the requested level(s) that is concordant with the individual's symptoms and physical exam findings
findings.note: Current version (V1.0.2026, eff 08/04/2026, pub 04/30/2026). CPT 63030 confirmed in codes table. CMM-608 Lumbar Decompression (same eff date) also available for laminectomy-only cases.

findings.title: Clinical Policy: Disc Decompression Procedures (CP.MP.114)
findings.quote: ≥ four weeks physical therapy or prescribed home exercise program, or documentation of member/enrollee's inability to tolerate
findings.note: Criteria section addresses open discectomy/microdiscectomy for radiculopathy. Caveat: coding table lists 62287 (percutaneous) as supporting coverage and does not enumerate 63030. Superior HealthPlan announced criteria changes to this policy eff 7/31/26.

No corporate CP.MP clinical policy exists for TKA. Ambetter states: 'Ambetter Health utilizes InterQual criteria for those medical technologies, procedures or pharmaceutical treatments for which a Ambetter Health clinical policy does not exist.' MSK surgery PA is delegated to TurningPoint in many states (criteria only by request at 1-855-444-0303) or Evolent/NIA (e.g., MO). Only stale state-specific policy found: PA.CP.MP.OR.1002 (PA Health & Wellness, 2020).
No CP.MP policy for THA in Ambetter clinical policy manual; defers to InterQual, with MSK surgery PA delegated to TurningPoint (GA/TX and others) or Evolent (MO); vendor criteria not publicly posted.
No CP.MP policy; InterQual per Ambetter statement; rotator cuff repair listed in TurningPoint MSK Surgical Quality and Safety Management program (criteria by request only).
No CP.MP policy; InterQual per Ambetter statement; shoulder arthroplasty listed in TurningPoint MSK program (criteria by request only).
No CP.MP policy; InterQual per Ambetter statement; ACL repair listed in TurningPoint MSK program (criteria by request only).

No CP.MP policy for cervical fusion; InterQual per Ambetter statement; cervical fusion listed in TurningPoint MSK program (criteria by request only).
No CP.MP policy; InterQual per Ambetter statement; ankle arthroplasty listed in TurningPoint MSK program (criteria by request only).
No CP.MP policy for bunionectomy/hallux valgus; defaults to InterQual per Ambetter statement.

No CP.MP policy for advanced imaging; Ambetter advanced imaging PA is delegated to Evolent/NIA (RadMD) in most states; Evolent posts plan-specific guideline PDFs on radmd.com but no single stable Ambetter-national MSK MRI guideline URL was verified; otherwise InterQual.
